scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:engine
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:engine && npm run stage:engine && cd desktop && tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run stage:engine && cd desktop && tauri build
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src docs/help.json scripts/*.mjs tests *.json *.ts desktop/tauri.conf.json desktop/capabilities/*.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend/src docs/help.json scripts/*.mjs tests *.json *.ts desktop/tauri.conf.json desktop/capabilities/*.json
